title: Get Qujingtai · Downloads & web access
description: Find web access and release status for Windows, macOS, Android and iOS.
heading: A way in that works for you.
intro: Use the web app, or choose a client for your device.
webBody: Open your inspiration and everyday workspace in a browser, without installing an app.
platformNote: Version and download availability are listed separately for each platform.
miniBody: The container approach and platform capabilities still need separate validation. No access link is available yet.
noticeBody: Check the version, CPU architecture and SHA-256 before installing, and use the links provided on this page. Each download identifies whether it is a test or production release.
androidBody: Includes the GeckoView browser engine, so no separate system WebView upgrade is needed. Choose ARM64 for most phones.
androidInstall: Open the downloaded APK and follow Android’s prompt to allow installation from the current source. You can revoke that permission afterwards. These are debug-signed test builds; upgrade details for a production release will be provided separately.
